<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="37" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">BAN bilinear attention  |  Module overview</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">module only / reviewed fixed source / independent operands  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="140.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f8d4e1" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="163.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="163.0" dy="0">Inputs</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="325.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c8ebfb" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="348.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="348.0" dy="0">Propagation</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="510.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="533.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="533.0" dy="0">Parameters</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="695.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#fff6bd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="718.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="718.0" dy="0">Add / norm</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="880.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#cdeaf8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="903.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="903.0" dy="0">Tensor ops</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1065.0" y="773" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9f1cd" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1088.0" y="786" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1088.0" dy="0">Gates</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="510.0" y="803" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f3f5f7" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="533.0" y="816" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="533.0" dy="0">Topology</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="695.0" y="803" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="718.0" y="816" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="718.0" dy="0">Output</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="844" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Read bottom to top; all module internals follow the same direction.</tspan>
<tspan x="685.0" dy="16.52">Same operator color does not imply shared weights; instance/parameter identities are preserved in IR.</tspan>
<tspan x="685.0" dy="16.52">Solid edges carry values; dashed edges carry topology, shape or loop state. Library kernels stay opaque.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="918" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="948" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="685.0" y="973" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="685.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
